field.name: setIds
field.comment: A JSON array of the IDs of the file sets the files must belong to

field.name: folderID
field.comment: The ID of the file folder holding the files to be listed (0: the root folder)

field.name: setMode
field.comment: any: the files must belong to any of the file sets listed in setIds; all: they must belong to all of them

field.name: onlyCurrentUser
field.comment: true: only the files added by the visitor are listed; false or NULL: all of them are listed

field.name: tags
field.comment: The tags the files must have, separated by commas

field.name: viewProperties
field.comment: A JSON object pairing every column with how it's displayed: the key is a property of the files (thumbnail, filename, tags, date, extension, size, description, ak_<file attribute key ID>), the value is -1 (hidden), 1 (displayed) or 5 (sortable)

field.name: expandableProperties
field.comment: A JSON array of the properties displayed when a file is expanded: image, description, tags, filename, date, extension, size, or ak_<file attribute key ID>

field.name: searchProperties
field.comment: A JSON array of the properties the visitors can search the files by: keywords, type, extension, or ak_<file attribute key ID> (used if enableSearch is true)

field.name: orderBy
field.comment: The property the files are sorted by: title, set, date, filename, or ak_<file attribute key ID>

field.name: displayLimit
field.comment: How many files a page displays (0 or NULL: all of them)

field.name: displayOrderDesc
field.comment: true: the files are sorted in descending order; false: in ascending order

field.name: addFilesToSetID
field.comment: The ID of the file set the uploaded files are added to (0: none)

field.name: maxThumbWidth
field.comment: The maximum width, in pixels, of the thumbnails of the files

field.name: maxThumbHeight
field.comment: The maximum height, in pixels, of the thumbnails of the files

field.name: enableSearch
field.comment: true: the visitors are offered a form to search the files; false or NULL: they are not

field.name: heightMode
field.comment: auto: the table is as tall as its contents; fixed: it's fixedHeightSize pixels tall

field.name: downloadFileMethod
field.comment: force: the links to the files make the browser download them; browser: the browser decides whether to display them instead

field.name: fixedHeightSize
field.comment: The height of the table, in pixels (used if heightMode is fixed)

field.name: headerBackgroundColor
field.comment: The background color of the header of the table, as a CSS color such as rgb(255, 0, 0)

field.name: headerBackgroundColorActiveSort
field.comment: The background color of the column of the header the files are sorted by, as a CSS color such as rgb(255, 0, 0)

field.name: headerTextColor
field.comment: The color of the text of the header of the table, as a CSS color such as rgb(255, 0, 0)

field.name: allowFileUploading
field.comment: true: the visitors that are allowed to add files can upload them from the block; false or NULL: they can't

field.name: allowInPageFileManagement
field.comment: true: the visitors that are allowed to edit the files can manage them from the block; false or NULL: they can't

field.name: tableName
field.comment: The title displayed above the table

field.name: tableDescription
field.comment: The text displayed below the title of the table

field.name: tableStriped
field.comment: true: the rows of the table alternate two colors, the second one being rowBackgroundColorAlternate; false or NULL: they all look the same

field.name: rowBackgroundColorAlternate
field.comment: The color of the even rows of the table, as a CSS color such as rgb(255, 0, 0) (used if tableStriped is true)

field.name: hideFolders
field.comment: true: only the files are listed; false or NULL: the folders contained in the folder are listed too
